The Cabanatuan City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (CCDRRMC), under the leadership of Mayor Myca Elizabeth R. Vergara, conducted the Operational Briefing for Oplan Kaluluwa 2025 in preparation for the observance of All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day.

The activity aimed to ensure the coordinated deployment of personnel and resources across all public and private cemeteries within the City Government of Cabanatuan’s area of responsibility. Members of the Council, together with force multipliers and volunteers, were mobilized to maintain peace, order, and safety for all Cabanatueños during the long weekend of remembrance.

A coordination meeting with the Association of Barangay Captains of Cabanatuan City was held on October 29, 2025, to discuss key programs and initiatives with various city offices and agencies.

The City Health Center presented updates on the National Immunization Program, while the City Assessor’s Office conducted a Public Consultation on the Proposed Schedule of Market Values (SMV) mandated by Republic Act No. 12001. The City Livelihood and Cooperative Development Office also discussed the Barangay Officials Orientation on Cooperative Development.

Participating agencies included the PNP, BFP, DILG, City Budget Office, City Mayor’s Office, and Community Affairs Office, all reaffirming their support for barangay initiatives and city development efforts.

The City Government of Cabanatuan held the presentation of the Strategic Development Framework Report  today, October 23, 2025. The activity forms part of the ongoing Review, Updating, and Completion of the Comprehensive Land Use Plan (CLUP), Zoning Ordinance (ZO), Comprehensive Development Plan (CDP), and Local Development Investment Program (LDIP) of the city, in partnership with Palafox Associates Inc.

Attended by department heads, office heads, and members of the City Planning Team–Technical Working Group (TWG), the presentation aimed to finalize key strategies and frameworks that will guide Cabanatuan’s sustainable urban development and long-term growth.

The National Solid Waste Management Commission (NSWMC), through the DENR–Environmental Management Bureau (EMB), conducted the Monitoring and Validation of the 10-Year Ecological Solid Waste Management Plan of the City Government of Cabanatuan. The activity was held on October 22, 2025, with the Cabanatuan City Environment and Natural Resources Office (CCENRO).

As part of the validation, the team visited the City Waste Transfer Station Facility in Barangay Valle Cruz, where they were briefed on the city’s solid waste management operations and initiatives. The team also visited Barangays Communal, Magsaysay Norte, and Pagas to observe and assess the implementation of solid waste management programs at the barangay level.

On October 22, 2025, the City Government of Cabanatuan, through the City Engineer’s Office, visited the following schools in the city to conduct its annual inspection of school buildings.
• Wesleyan University Philippines
• Mayapyap National High School
• Honorato C. Perez Sr. Memorial Science High School
• Caalibangbangan National High School
• Cabanatuan North Elementary School

The visit focused on checking classrooms, offices, and other facilities to make sure they remain safe, functional, and ready to support students’ learning.

Through this yearly initiative, the City Government continues to show its strong commitment to the welfare of learners and teachers by ensuring that schools provide a secure and supportive environment. The findings from the inspection will also guide future improvements and upgrades to strengthen the city’s education infrastructure.
